merchant/31419.htm.text: Spellbook Seller Lorel: No matter the chaos that swirls around, a fragant breeze and sunlight still warm the heart... What brings you here? If you're looking for a spellbook, I can help you. If you want to learn magic, find a priest or magister in the temple.

links.text: "Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"
